note: Static list approved by the author. No catalogue crawling: scenes are added here by hand. Titles, author and licence checked on the scene pages on superspl.at (2026-09-24); voxelCm = voxelResolution from scene.voxel.json.

fields.walls: Admin default of the walls (collisions) switch for this scan: "on" or "off"; a missing field means "on". Use "off" for a noisy scan with many floating splats: the pilot then flies through everything with no crashes, and can still switch the walls on (C, the walls menu on the credit line, or Settings). A pilot's own choice for a scan is kept in their browser and wins over this default. Only scans that have walls are affected.
fields.scale: Admin-verified size of the scan (scene size, E.7): the default size for this scan, 0.25 to 4. A missing field means 1 (the scan is in true metres). A pilot's own size for a scan (the summary panel, [ and ], Settings -> Scenes) wins over it.
fields.dropFloaters: Admin default of the phantom-wall filter for this scan (G.3): a whole number 0 to 64; every connected piece of the walls smaller than this many blocks (4x4x4 voxels) is dropped from the collision, so floating splats of a noisy scan stop being invisible walls. A missing field means 0 (keep every piece). Check the scan with the voxel grid's "Floaters in red" style first: a large value can also drop thin real things (a lamp post, a railing). A pilot's own value for a scan (Settings -> Walls and voxel grid) wins over it. Only scans that have walls are affected.
